cand.title: SET’UP 2027 – Salon de l’évènementiel & du tourisme

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified commercial access contacts: Cyril Gautier, SET’UP exhibitor contact, sales@set-up.ch, +41 (0)78 311 72 27; and Caroline Oeuvray, SET’UP visitor contact, info@set-up.ch. Cyril is the first route for exhibiting/partnerships and organizer introductions; Caroline is relevant for visitor accreditation and planner-network access. Neither is established as hotel-contract signatory or accommodation buyer. No named housing manager was verified.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming within the requested horizon: 20–21 January 2027, Palexpo Genève, Hall 4, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. These are activity dates on the organizer site and ticketing page, not publication dates. The brochure calls this the second edition. No official 2028 edition/date/venue announcement was located; do not project January 2028. Exact opening time is inconsistent: ticketing header 09:30 versus descriptive copy/brochure 09:00; this does not affect the verified dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment using the supplied hotel constraints: prioritize sales access to corporate planners for future Founex/La Côte meetings, training and retreats, rather than moving this exhibition to the hotel. Expected 2,600 visitors are not a room requirement and exceed the hotel’s supplied meeting capacity. Conditional secondary role: a separately sourced organizer/exhibitor team or small satellite lodging block, only if overnight needs, transport and absence of centralized contracting are confirmed. Use roughly 20–120 rooms as a prospecting envelope, not published demand; do not assume all 237 rooms. Position the six supplied meeting rooms and up-to-250 theatre capability honestly; banquet/restaurant scale needs validation. No resort requirement is published. YOTEL already has a SET’UP portfolio page, and an organizer-reposted February 2026 account places Clara Brusés of YOTEL Geneva Lake at the first edition: this is relationship reactivation, not a cold lead or verified hotel booking.
findings.venueCommitments: Publicly announced venue: Palexpo Genève, Hall 4. This is a convention/exhibition venue, not an incumbent hotel. Territorial classification: Geneva Airport corridor, Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte and not downtown Geneva. The brochure says Palexpo is “idéalement située à proximité immédiate de l’aéroport de Genève”. This establishes airport proximity, not that delegates fly or stay toward La Côte. No venue contract was inspected. Lausanne/French-border travel-evidence condition is not applicable to this venue.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified predecessor: 6–7 February 2026, Palexpo Genève, Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Palexpo lists Pimp My Team as organizer. The 2027 brochure explicitly says “SET UP ÉVOLUE POUR SA 2 ÈME ÉDITION” and “ILS ÉTAIENT PRÉSENTS EN 2026”. Two successive editions at the same venue are verified; no destination rotation is demonstrated. The first edition served private individuals and professionals; 2027 is positioned 100% B2B. The legacy exhibitor brochure contains an internally inconsistent “VENDREDI 6 FÉVRIER 2025” line; use Palexpo’s explicit 2026 dates instead.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 hotel sourcing is unconfirmed. No edition-specific housing bureau appointment, host hotel, named accommodation block, booking code, open RFP, peak rooms or room nights was located. The legacy first-edition brochure says “EN CAS DE BESOIN D’HÉBERGEMENT HÔTELIER, CONTACTER: INFO@SET-UP.CH”; this is a historical organizer-contact pathway, not a 2027 commitment. No hotels are named as contracted housing in the reviewed materials. Palexpo Hotel Reservation advertises a generic service including “pré-réservation d’un contingent de chambres”; there is no retrieved evidence that SET’UP appointed it. Hotel exhibitor listings are not housing allocations.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate-led trade show, not an association-owned conference established by the evidence. SET’UP is the event brand; 2027 ticketing names Pimp My Team and the official legal notice identifies site proprietor PIMP MY TEAM SNC, CH-660.0.347.019-3, Cours des Bastions 13, 1205 Genève. Executive & PA Network is a legally separate nonprofit association and explicitly states it is proud to “co-organise” the 2027 event. The brochure assigns it B2B visitor qualification/corporate network activation. Palexpo is the venue. Precise contractual division, event-IP ownership and hotel-buying authority remain unverified; no separate housing PCO/DMC appointment was found.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced sell-out, overflow shortage, displaced attendees, open hotel inventory or lodging commitment to a competing hotel was located. Published 2027 hotel exhibitors include Royal Savoy Hotel & Spa Lausanne, Le Palace de Menthon, Jiva Hill Resort, Beau-Rivage Palace, Lausanne Palace, Hôtel Palafitte, Riffelalp Resort 2’222m, Hotel d’Angleterre and The Chesterfield Mayfair; these are competitive suppliers, not host hotels. Additional hospitality brands/groups are also advertised as exhibitors, not accommodation allocations. As a Founex hotel, YOTEL requires a transport/convenience case for Palexpo attendees. Organizer posts state “Only suppliers exhibiting with a stand will be permitted access to the forum”; because that post does not itself name the edition/forum scope, confirm its application to 2027 rather than assuming free visitor entry for hotel sales staff.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First check YOTEL’s existing SET’UP participation/contact history, including Clara Brusés’ documented first-edition connection; do not assume her role is unchanged. Approach Cyril Gautier to confirm 2027 supplier-access rules, current exhibitor/partner terms, and whether organizer/exhibitor accommodation is centrally contracted, referred or self-booked. Ask for the named lodging decision-maker and actual overnight team requirements before proposing rooms. Approach Caroline Oeuvray for appropriate corporate-planner introductions and accreditation, not an invented housing mandate. Explore an agreed Founex site inspection or future small-meeting presentation, subject to transport, catering and buyer interest. Record room demand as unverified until a dated brief identifies stay dates, peak rooms, budget and contracting party.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 visitor accreditation/ticketing is published and exhibitor participation is marketed. This establishes trade-show participation access, not available lodging demand. Free visitor registration on the homepage is not permission for a hotel supplier to bypass exhibitor rules. The homepage advertises exhibitor entry from CHF 3,699 while the commercial brochure gives CHF 3,999 excluding tax for two days; confirm the applicable offer and benefits before committing spend. Existing YOTEL/Clara Brusés first-edition visibility creates a credible warm introduction. Current hotel inventory capture remains unqualified.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: strongest value is repeat planner relationships and downstream corporate-event briefs suitable for Founex/La Côte, not primary housing for this Palexpo exhibition. The verified 2026–2027 sequence supports recurrence evidence but no 2028 date, venue or sourcing window is published. Seek permission to present YOTEL to Executive & PA Network buyers and to compete for future independently sourced meetings or exhibitor-team stays. No future allocation or win probability can be claimed.
